company_info.company_description: "Why choose Enviro Projects?Finding a reputable renewables provider is confusing. With so many suppliers out there it’s difficult to sort the pretenders from the real deal. We get it, you want to make sure your initial investment is one that lasts!At Enviro Projects, we view solar as an honest partnership between customer and supplier. Just as you value your return on investment, we value our reputation. For the last fifteen years we’ve proven ourselves as one of the most trusted solar suppliers for homeowners.Our approach to solar and renewables is simple. We use our unique energy-modelling technology to accurately report and compare power usage and to accurately project your savings potential.Once we install your panels our job doesn’t just end there. Each year we provide you with an idea of how much you’re spending, how much you’re saving, and, most importantly, work with you to refine your energy expenditure for the future. That’s why we call it a partnership.Honest and Reliable Local ServiceWe have built an efficient team of professional installers located all over Australia. Our “local approach” to installation management means we can efficiently and expertly meet deadlines and, most importantly, provide ongoing 24/7 maintenance and support for the entire life of your system."

reviews.review_description: I had an amazing experience with Enviro Projects! From start to finish, their team was professional, knowledgeable, and efficient. They took the time to explain the entire process, answered all my questions, and provided a competitive quote for a quality solar system for our new home.The installation was smooth, and the crew was punctual and cleaned up after themselves. My solar system is now up and running, and I’m already seeing savings on my energy bill!I highly recommend Enviro Projects to anyone considering solar. Great service, high-quality panels, and excellent customer support! ??
A very professional team, did everything they promised, the quote was in line with what was on offer for a quality system Did organise grid connection and got in contact for a follow up. Very happy.

We couldn't be more impressed with the work of Matt Harold at Australian Enviro Projects.He quoted and arranged for the installation of a 60kw solar system and 6 Franklin Batteries for our dairy farm in South West Victoria.  Matt made the experience very stress free and was great to deal with. He was very prompt and thorough at looking at our energy usage and making suggestions as to the best system to go with.  The installers Matt arranged - Alex Pye Electrics - were easy to deal with as well and have done a great job.  The job was completed on time and the site was left tidy.  We are rapt with the performance of the system and batteries so far.
Sales quote was quick. Matt took time to personally meet up, inquire about needs and explain the system he recommends.

Sales/quoting representative was knowledgeable, informative and timely - very pleased with process.Installer was professional, knowledgeable, tidy, polite and considerate in leaving our home tidy.After installation customer service by both sales representative and installer continues to be excellent ensuring grid connections and internet connections seamless - very impressed and happy.

The whole process of quoting and sales was quick, simple and smooth, lasting within a week. The installation followed soon after and completed within two days, without any problems. The after sale services were also great, responsive, prompt and effective. In short, I am very happy with the entire process, from start to finish and would strongly recommend this company to any prospective customer.

The quote was straight forward and easy to understand. Any questions I had were very promptly answered.Installation was all done and dusted in a morning after an earlier inspection to check the location for inverter and panels. Friendly and efficient team.Customer Service was great. They organised everything with Energex for the grid connection and connection to the ap to track how much power I am generating. I simply contacted my electricity supplier to let them know the solar was connected and was advised my meter has to be re-configured. I will be receiving a rebate on my solar from the connection date.Highly recommended - Australian Enviro Projects, Sunshine Coast
A few hiccups during the quoting phase but the installation and subsequent operation have been seamless

Matt was friendly and easy going. Answered all my questions promptly even those between quote and install. I felt at ease with him. Comparatively, with others I know, my system was similarly priced. Not knocking the price but you'd always like to have paid less! I think I got a good quality system with Australian points of contact if needed. Thomas was great with the install. I'm sorry I missed the name of his assistant but they were on time, efficient. and worked well together.

The quoting process was very beneficial as all 3 firms came to site to quote.We chose Australian Enviro Projects as they had a good track record and their solution was right for our property.The installers came to check the layout ahead of the installation day and discussed our needs.Then the installation proceeded on time and very efficiently and neatly, the monitoring app and product registration work seemlessly.They also organised the retailer to change the meter.
Everything went very smoothly and we got the right solar panels and battery. (Tesla)

Matt came out to give us a quote. Explained everything well, and was humble in his approach. There were no hard sell or polished sales techniques, just good advice. Done well to explain he only uses Australian backed quality products. His company also supports local sporting groups, which are both a bonus in my book.Installers were great, communicated well, explained along the way and left the site tidy. Insulation looked to be of a high standard.After sales service has been great with a follow up call, and he has always answered any of my questions when I’ve made contact. Matt will monitor my solar for the life of the system, so if any problems arise, they’ll be right onto it.I can recommend Matt and the team for all you solar needs.
We were very happy with discussions with Matt from Enviro Projects and found the team and process professional

Would highly recommend Matt and his team. Great customer service, lovely team. He made suggestions specifically for us and how we use our power. Other quote made standard suggestions not specifically for our needs

The sales and quoting process was seemless, Matt's knowledge of the current state of the industry was very helpful.The installation went perfectly.  Thomas and the crew were punctual, tidy and kept me up to date with progress.  The end result is a very neat installation that looks perfect, and exactly as planned.They helped organise the grid connection and removal of hot water tariff.

Out of five quotes Australian Enviro Projects offered the best quality of components at a price only slightly more expensive than those with lower quality panels and inverter. The clincher was the tight deadline that I gave them for installation which they were able to meet. So quote received on the Tuesday, accepted on the Wednesday. Panels delivered on the Friday and installed on the Saturday !!!

Matt and his team were the only installers willing to go the extra mile on a non-standard installation where the panels had to be installed landscape. I would highly recommend if you're looking for someone who will listen to your requirements and advise the best system for your needs and roof layout.
Sales and quoting was professional. Installation was efficient and tidy.Customer service was very good.

I got three solar panel installers suggested by "solarquotes". Matt made the most convincing offer for a comparable price. I am fully satisfied with the service and installed panels. The company was very patient and able to reschedule several times which was necessary because the roof needed to be repainted prior to the installation. This had to be delayed because of ongoing rain. They were very tidy and fast.  I highly recommend Australian Enviro Projects.

I did extensive research, receiving around 6 quotes in all, the check sheet allowed me to compare more accurately the systems and inclusions/exclusions. Australian Enviro Projects sent their installer (Thomas) to have a look at the roof to ensure what was quoted was possible, we then decided an install date and time; Thomas arrived exactly as he promised with his fellow installers not far behind, the installation completed in one day and power being generated immediately, connection to the grid was completed before Thomas left for the day.All in all; we are very happy with the choice we made and have recommended Aust Enviro Projects to our friends.

From the initial visit and comprehensive information given tailored to our situation to the installation and quality of products used we are totally satisfied with the  outcome and ongoing support. No hesitation in recommending Matt and his team of professionals.

I chose Australian Enviro Project after doing lots of solar research.I found Matt to be extremely knowledgeable from proposal to installation, he answered all my questions honestly and patiently.The installers were extremely professional and efficient.I am so happy with the layout, it has been installed with pride and to perfection.The price was totally reasonable considering high end quality panels and inverter being installed.The whole process was easy and seamless from initiation to installation.
Great service, smooth instal and well explained.Good communication, on time and tidy. Thank you team!

Matt provided the most information of any of the companies and with no pressure - he also guided us through buying the right system (& quality) for future possibilities. He could have sold us a bigger system, but sold us what was right for us, not for him.

Matt came out and visited my Mum and IThe two other companies we met tried to talk us into a 10Kw solar system but Matt explained why we only needed 6kW which impressed us.We were clearly shown how much the solar would save us and the quality of products seemed good.Thomas came and installed the system within 2 weeks and did a great job.Matt has called us twice since the solar went in to make sure we were happy and gave us advice on which power company to go with.We would highly recommend Enviro Projects
Whole process, very easy from start to finish. Polite, efficient, punctual.
The installation went without any problems, great service and assistance with the connection process. I am very happy with my choice and can highly recommend this installer.

Quote was simple, Matt arrived talked us thru the options and let us decide. No hard sell just these are the 2 options and this is his recommendation.Install was very professional! Cleaned up after themselves.They helped get everything sorted and followed up a year later to ensure everything was still running as it should!

The quoting process was easy and efficient and not the least bit pushy. The installation was stress free and the installer explained everything really well. The customer service was excellent. They noticed that the setup wasn't working one day and came out to check it for us. The reason it wasn't working was that the power had been turned off while a smart meter was installed by our energy provider. Fantastic service!
Trusted Matt from the beginning and was not wrong. Great system, install, now going for 2 years and no problems at all.
Fantastic thanks guys love your work on time fast and friendly

Matt from Enviro projects visited us the next day after getting in touch, and provided us with a quality proposal detailing savings and the products the company uses.The system was installed less than 2 weeks after we gave them the go ahead. Thomas and his team were very efficient., and from what I can see did a high level installation. My husband is a builder and was impressed so it must be good!!The company followed up 1 week after installation and before we had to pay anything which I thought was great.,Highly recommend Matt and his team

It is a larger system (~40kw Winaco panels 2x 15kw Fronius Symo inverter), installed on a difficult site (45 degree roof pitch 6m eaves), and installation has not yet been completed.However, after discussions with 4 companies, enviro projects was the clear winner.  He wanted to do the work, and went the extra mile to make sure we got what we needed.  Looked into the other features that we wanted performed at the same time (whirley birds, bird mesh and gutter guard).  In the end client performed whirley birds and gutter guard.  Client supplied bird mesh and solar installer installed the bird mesh for no additional cost.  This was appreciated due to the access hazard etc.Very happy that Enviro Projects offered the highest quality equipment of all offerings, yet was the lowest cost (only by a very small margin).  Other quoters offered single 30kw sun grow inverter and range of panels most recommending Canadian solar, due to their recent increase to 25yr product warranty.  This was the only cheaper panel that could match Winaco's 25yr product warranty.  Also, two Fronius inverters allowed 4 trackers, and therefore the ability to mount panels on three different angled roof surfaces, broadening the power peak.  75% of panels mounted on 45 degree N-NE facing roof, 15% on W-NW 45 degree roof and 10% on N-NW 10 degree roof.

We caught up with Matt from Enviro Projects 18 months ago and he talked us out of upgrading our solar as the existing system was working well and we were not sure how long we were staying in our house.We moved and contacted Matt who helped us with a new system. His advice was clear ad honest, and the install from Thomas and his team fantastic.They followed us up 4 weeks after install to make sure we were happy, and have helped us choose the best retail power company.I would highly recommend this company for excellent customer service and value for money..

AVOID IF YOU CARE FOR YOUR INVESTMENT- The sales process offered me $500 higher quotation compared to a friend whom I referred him to the company at the same time.- They offered me a system then by reviewing the contract I figured out the system in the quotation is different than the contract and when highlighted the point they offered apologies and modified the contract, if I didn't highlight they wont be honest and flag it.- The installation was dirty and left a hole in my wall and to compensate me they offered a $50 eGift card!!- At the first problem I faced, they called me yelling not to msg them anymore and clearly threatening that there is no one in the company that will help me through my problem because he is the owner!!! and when I said I will send an official mail to the company they hanged up the phone while I was speaking.Worst experience and many of other close friends I personally know reported installation problems, looks like it is a common problem.TAKE CARE
Great customer service. Matt and his team were very helpful
The entire installation process went very smoothly.Congratulations to the entire team!
Very helpful and a follow up phone call,  great service.
Super helpful, friendly and efficient help with selecting a system and installation.

And his price was very competitive, particularly using more premium products. The install happened quickly after giving the go ahead and the follow up service was outstanding. This was right before Christmas, so I can understand that not much was happening.  Now that we are in the New Year, we will see how long it takes to get this straightened out. Great service. Happy on all levels. Very helpful and knowledgeable.

Sales process was simple and easy to understand. Not over the top in the ‘selling’ of the system. Matt was obviously a genuine person who believed in his company and his system. Thomas installed the system and was very professional. I have no hesitation in recommending Enviro Projects.

sales quoting process was informative & Matt answered  all our questions.Installation was very tidy. installer rang to say he was on his way. Very polite and tidy.Customer Service was excellent.we felt comfortable ringing sales person when we neededWe had problems with the finance company so arranged to pay cash so we're given a very good discountWould recommend this company.

Upfront with costs and what was involved, definitely didn’t feel like a sales pitch - just clear info. They did everything they said they would, when they said they were going to. The installer even came over before the actual install just to answer questions and make me feel at ease that there would be not hidden costs/problems. They organised everything including replacing the meter and connecting to the grid. It just made it so easy!
All good. Very happy with the complete package from enviro projects.

Sales/quoting was good, not pushy at all,  just presented a product and left it to me to decide.Installation/installers were on time, tidy, cleaned up afterwards, kept me updated, professional,  couldn't ask for any more.Customer service post install has been great to this point

I had 3 quotes from Solar Quotes recommended installers. All were solid and reputable companies, but Enviro Projects stood out as the clear choice due to Matt's product knowledge and professionalism. He used real data to calculate the ideal system size for my house, location and electricity needs, then gave brand options to suit my budget. Matt didn't "add on" to the quote like other companies did. For example, the mounting rails were quoted at $950 from another company, but were included in the price with Enviro Projects. Ended up saving a few grand compared to an identical system from the next best quote.We now have a fantastic 10kW system (Winaico panels) with 8.2kW Fronius inverter. Our first power bill (after 2 Winter months, with a few rainy weeks) went from quite expensive to almost zero. Install went flawlessly with the electrician completing some other existing electrical work at a reasonable price.Communication and follow up have been excellent, with Matt checking in and following up with any questions after receiving our first electricity bill.Have and will be recommending Enviro Projects to others.Thanks again Matt!

Matt provided a great solution for our flat roof in Melbourne and answered all my queries promptly and with expert knowledge.I requested a number of quotes and options from providers and in my opinion the quality of the panel type, inverter and workmanship was second highest (if not highest) whilst the price was very competitive and in the lower price bracket.On installation day the original plan had to be modified due to location of roof hardpoints (which can't be seen from the aerial photos). Fortunately plan B worked perfectly. The installation was as described, punctual, professional, tidy and efficient. It happened as described and in good time. The panels are working very well this winter so can't wait to see them in action over summer. Overall we are very pleased with the result and recommend using Australian Enviro Projects Pty Ltd.

Australian Enviro Projects provided a comprehensive quote which helped in making our decision.   We were impressed with the prompt, courteous service with fantastic communication.   We would definitely recommend Matt and his team to any prospective solar customer.

professional from quotation through installation , instruction & after sales follow up. We highly recommend Enviro projects.

Very efficient, honest team. Was super impressed with Mattâ€™s passion to get the right system for our needs. The installation process was simple, couldnâ€™t be happier. Great company.

We evaluated 4 quotes with a mix of system configurations. In the end, we chose Enviro Projects due to the high quality system components and knowledgeable installer (Thanks Zeke!). Installers were all professional and friendly.We are very satisfied with our experience and look forward to our lower power bills!Thanks guys!

We got 5 quotes before deciding to go with Matt from Enviro Projects. As the title says - the price was good, the customer service was great and the install job was fantastic.With our 6.6kW system we have been in credit in summer and averaging a $20-30 dollar electricity bill in winter.
Carl did a fantastic job installing my system and it is running very well.  It will be a while before I see my first bill, but I am optimistic it will make a real difference.
I am very pleased with the company and the system I chose. Thankyou for making my task so easy and simple.

Zeke Roland and his Team were pleasant to have at my place, and nothing was to much trouble for them. Great company. Top quality equipment installed by very professional staff. Would highly recommend.
Matt and his staff at Australian Enviro Projects Mooloolaba were a pleasure to deal with . Very prompt and efficient service, great communication and very adaptable to my needs.

I can recommend Australian Enviro Projects. Amazing service from quotation right through to installation. Everything about the process was well managed and the information provided was clear and understandable.
